subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should the repository-wide `PNPM_CONFIG_VERIFY_DEPS_BEFORE_RUN=false` CI policy change land with this Signal bug fix, or be split and reviewed independently?
rationale: The Signal change is localized, but the global pnpm setting changes execution behavior for many CI commands and requires repository-owner judgment about dependency-install guarantees.

options.title: Split CI policy from Signal repair
options.body: Merge-review the Signal newline fix independently and move the global pnpm behavior change into a focused CI PR with job-wide dependency-setup proof.

options.title: Accept the combined change
options.body: Keep the CI change here after an owner verifies that every affected CI job explicitly validates or installs dependencies before running pnpm commands.

recommendation.title: Split CI policy from Signal repair
recommendation.body: Merge-review the Signal newline fix independently and move the global pnpm behavior change into a focused CI PR with job-wide dependency-setup proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignee authored the CI and Signal changes and is best positioned to provide the intended CI contract and proof context.
